scope: Read-only audit of B-DVIB seed 0 frozen screen and mandatory real-control aggregates; no person arrays, rerun, refit, or threshold change.
finding: The frozen income shuffled-label LR control fails. The probe uses the same ordered ATT/INNER people and complete attack matrices as the screen. Static inspection found no matrix-swap or shared implementation fault. It permutes whole ATT fit-group SEX label vectors within group-size buckets, fits LR on those labels, and scores true INNER SEX with the predeclared positive/reverse AUC envelope. A high shuffled score can arise from chance or feature geometry; this single result does not identify its cause.
disposition: B-DVIB seed 0 fails a mandatory engineering control. Do not claim its affected income or full-arm comparison as independently valid, rerun it, or change the cap. Preserve the screen and failure receipts. Unrelated frozen B arms may continue under the unchanged evaluator and their own mandatory control gates.
